left.raw_text: Outpatient with primary DSM- IV OCD

Completion of a 14-week open label trial of one the following SRI's: fluoxetine 80 mg/day, paroxetine 60 mg/day, fluvoxamine 300 mg/day, clomipramine 250 mg/day, sertraline 200 mg/day, citalopram 60 mg/day, escitalopram 30 mg/day
and demonstrating a non or partial responses to SRI treatment

right.raw_text: Stable (8 wks or longer) concurrent medications including benzodiazepines, sedative hypnotics, antipsychotics, and antidepressants.
